cond_0001.intro:
The Debug team in the Server Platform Solution Engineering Group is looking for a debug engineer to accelerate debug and drive innovation in the debug space on flag products. The scope includes hands-on work with cutting edge server hardware and software technologies in a challenging environment leading up to platform launch. In this role you will work with design, architecture, validation and manufacturing engineering teams to solve critical issues to meet customer quality expectations.
The individual has a strong understanding of the general silicon engineering process, from concept to tape-out and then production. A successful candidate must have outstanding verbal, as well as written, communication skills.
cond_0001.responsibilities: The debug lead is expected to provide root cause analysis for logical, performance, firmware, circuit marginality and manufacturing defects. Define and validate workarounds for silicon bugs. Improve debug capabilities and methodology over time by identifying common challenges or impediments to efficient debug and working with partner organizations to drive innovation in silicon architecture, design, tools and methods. Manage and track technical issues, risks and priorities. Manage customer and executive communications, including program status, risks and opportunities. Mentor and train engineers in x86 and debug techniques.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
10+ Years of experience developing SoC (design, architecture, pre-silicon validation or post-silicon validation)
Strong knowledge of X86 architecture, power management, SoC design, cache coherency protocols and data center industry standard busses (PCIE, CXL, etc)
Exceptional understanding of platform hardware, operating system, device drivers and system BIOS interactions
A thorough understanding of datacenter industry technologies and their software stack
Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical/Computer Engineering or Electronics/Computer Science related
Preferred Requirements
Experience defining and coding debug tools
Strong probability and statistics background including DOEs
Knowledgeable in DFD and DFT technologies
Innovation track record (publications and patents)

cond_0202.intro:
The Debug team in the Server Platform Solution Engineering Group is looking for a debug engineer to accelerate debug and drive innovation in the debug space on flag products. The scope includes hands-on work with cutting edge server hardware and software technologies in a challenging environment leading up to platform launch. In this role you will work with design, architecture, validation and manufacturing engineering teams to solve critical issues to meet customer quality expectations.
The individual has a strong understanding of the general silicon engineering process, from concept to tape-out and then production. A successful candidate must have outstanding verbal, as well as written, communication skills. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of silicon debug and the systems involved.

Improve debug capabilities and methodology over time by identifying common challenges or impediments to efficient debug and working with partner organizations to drive innovation in silicon architecture, design, tools and methods. Manage and track technical issues, risks and priorities. Manage customer and executive communications, including program status, risks and opportunities. Mentor and train engineers in x86 and debug techniques.

Manage and track technical issues, risks, and priorities. Manage customer and executive communications, including program status, risks, and opportunities — regularly walking stakeholders through findings and handling questions directly. Mentor and train engineers in x86 and debug techniques.
cond_0321.requirements:
10+ Years of experience developing SoC (design, architecture, pre-silicon validation or post-silicon validation)
A thorough understanding of datacenter industry technologies and their software stack.
Strong knowledge of X86 architecture, power management, SoC design, cache coherency protocols, and data center industry standard busses (PCIE, CXL, etc).
Exceptional understanding of platform hardware, operating system, device drivers, and system BIOS interactions.
Experience defining and coding debug tools.
Strong probability and statistics background including DOEs.
Knowledgeable in DFD and DFT technologies.
Innovation track record (publications and patents).
Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical/Computer Engineering or Electronics/Computer Science related.

cond_0461.intro:
The Debug team in the Server Platform Solution Engineering Group is looking for a debug engineer to accelerate debug and drive innovation in the debug space on flag products. The scope includes hands-on work with cutting edge server hardware and software technologies in a challenging environment leading up to platform launch. In this role you will work with design, architecture, validation and manufacturing engineering teams to solve critical issues to meet customer quality expectations.
The individual has a strong understanding of the general silicon engineering process, from concept to tape-out and then production. A successful candidate must have outstanding verbal, as well as written, communication skills.
cond_0461.responsibilities: The debug lead is expected to provide root cause analysis for logical, performance, firmware, circuit marginality and manufacturing defects. Define and validate workarounds for silicon bugs. Improve debug capabilities and methodology over time by identifying common challenges or impediments to efficient debug and working with partner organizations to drive innovation in silicon architecture, design, tools and methods. Manage and track technical issues, risks and priorities. Manage customer and executive communications, including program status, risks and opportunities. Mentor and train engineers in x86 and debug techniques.
cond_0461.requirements:
Minimum 10 years of demonstrated expertise developing SoC (design, architecture, pre-silicon validation or post-silicon validation).
Deep knowledge of datacenter industry technologies and their software stack.
Advanced knowledge of X86 architecture, Power management, SoC design, cache coherency protocols and Data Center industry standard busses (PCIE, CXL, etc).
Exceptional understanding of platform hardware, Operating System, Device Drivers and System BIOS interactions.
Proven track record defining and coding debug tools.
Substantial probability and statistics background including DOEs.
Strong command of DFD and DFT technologies.
Demonstrated innovation track record (publications and patents).
Bachelor's degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering or Electronics/Computer Science required; advanced degree strongly preferred.

cond_0487.intro:
The Debug team in the Server Platform Solution Engineering Group is looking for a debug engineer to accelerate debug and drive innovation in the debug space on flag products. The scope includes hands-on work with cutting edge server hardware and software technologies in a challenging environment leading up to platform launch. In this role you will work with design, architecture, validation and manufacturing engineering teams to solve critical issues to meet customer quality expectations.
The individual has a strong understanding of the general silicon engineering process, from concept to tape-out and then production. A successful candidate must have outstanding verbal, as well as written, communication skills.
cond_0487.responsibilities: The debug lead is expected to provide root cause analysis for logical, performance, firmware, circuit marginality and manufacturing defects. Define and validate workarounds for silicon bugs. Improve debug capabilities and methodology over time by identifying common challenges or impediments to efficient debug and working with partner organizations to drive innovation in silicon architecture, design, tools and methods. Manage and track technical issues, risks and priorities. Manage customer and executive communications, including program status, risks and opportunities. Mentor and train engineers in x86 and debug techniques.

10+ Years of experience developing SoC (design, architecture, pre-silicon validation or post-silicon validation)
Strong knowledge of X86 architecture, power management, SoC design, cache coherency protocols and data center industry standard busses (PCIE, CXL, etc)
Exceptional understanding of platform hardware, operating system, device drivers and system BIOS interactions
A thorough understanding of datacenter industry technologies and their software stack
Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical/Computer Engineering or Electronics/Computer Science related
Preferred Requirements
Experience defining and coding debug tools
Strong probability and statistics background including DOEs
Knowledgeable in DFD and DFT technologies
Innovation track record (publications and patents)
